_about: Named places with coordinates sourced from OpenStreetMap via Nominatim (osm id recorded per entry). kind=stop entries supply coordinates for OCCT stops the schedule pages name but stop_cache.json lacks; kind=place entries are campus/area landmarks users can type instead of an address. Never hand-edit lat/lon without a source.
